paper.title_en: A Song of Spice and Ice: A diagonal dual to dS$_3$ & its Galilean flat space limit
paper.abstract_en: We propose a diagonal CFT dual to asymptotically de Sitter spacetimes in three dimensions (3d), constructed from the holomorphic part of the CFT dual at the future boundary and the antiholomorphic part of the CFT dual at the past boundary, in part inspired by an antipodal map between the two CFT copies. This gives equal and opposite imaginary central charges for the holomorphic and antiholomorphic sectors. The corresponding diagonal holographic energy-momentum tensor expectation values are constructed from the Wavefunction at the future boundary and its conjugate. This enables a recovery of the entropy of $dS_3$, as well as a family of complex Kerr $dS_3$ spacetimes with two real horizons, by a Cardy formula. We then explore the flatspace limit of our dS construction. With the central charges as above, the flatspace limit naturally induces a Galilean contraction on the dual diagonal 2d CFT, in contrast to the more familiar Carrollian limit when 3d Asymptotically Flat Spacetime (AFS) is approached from $AdS_3$. The corresponding limit for the complex Kerr family above leaves the inner horizon intact, resulting in flat space complex black holes ($\mathbb{C}$BH) that are closely related to flat space cosmologies which arise from BTZ black holes in AdS$_3$. We recover the entropy of these $\mathbb{C}$BHs by the BMS-Cardy formula.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 提出dS₃的全息对偶构造并探讨其Galilean平直极限，涉及熵的Cardy公式恢复与复Kerr解，理论深度和概念新颖性较高，属于引力基础与黑洞热力学交叉的值得跟进工作。
decision.title_zh: 香料与冰之歌：dS₃的对角对偶及其伽利略平直空间极限
decision.abstract_zh: 我们提出一个对角CFT对偶，对偶于三维渐近de Sitter时空（3d），由未来边界上CFT对偶的全纯部分与过去边界上CFT对偶的反全纯部分构造而成，部分受到两个CFT副本之间对跖映射的启发。这给出全纯与反全纯扇区相等且相反的虚中心荷。相应的对角全息能量-动量张量期望值由未来边界处的波函数及其共轭构造。这使我们能够通过Cardy公式恢复$dS_3$的熵，以及一族具有两个实视界的复Kerr $dS_3$时空。随后我们探索我们dS构造的平直空间极限。在如上中心荷下，平直空间极限自然地在对偶对角2d CFT上诱导出一个伽利略收缩，这与从$AdS_3$逼近3d渐近平直时空（AFS）时更为熟悉的Carrollian极限形成对比。上述复Kerr族对应的极限使内视界保持完整，从而得到平直空间复黑洞（$\mathbb{C}$BH），它们与由$AdS_3$中BTZ黑洞产生的平直空间宇宙学密切相关。我们通过BMS-Cardy公式恢复这些$\mathbb{C}$BH的熵。
